map.Min-Max 特征缩放器，将特征值线性缩放到 [0,1] 或 [−1,1] 区: Min-Max feature scaler, scaling feature values linearly into [0,1] or [-1,1] for machine learning normalization preprocessing; note that max must not equal min.
map.x′ = (x − min)/(max − min)；[-1,1] 映射 x″: x' = (x - min)/(max - min); the [-1,1] mapping is x'' = 2x' - 1; Z-score approximates (x - x_bar)/((max - min)/2)
map.Min-Max 把特征线性压到固定区间，保留原始分布形状但不改变相对关系；缺点是: Min-Max compresses features linearly into a fixed interval, preserving the original distribution shape without changing relative relations; the drawback is being dominated by outliers (one extreme value squeezes the rest into a narrow band). Tree models need no scaling, while gradient-descent and distance-based models usually must have it.
map.[0,1] 缩放 x'=(x−min)/(max−min)；[−1,1] 缩放: [0,1] scaling x' = (x - min)/(max - min); [-1,1] scaling x' = 2(x - min)/(max - min) - 1.
map.要求 max≠min，否则分母为零；异常值会压缩正常样本区间。: Requires max not equal to min, otherwise the denominator is zero; outliers will compress the normal sample range.
map.缩放到固定区间利于梯度下降与距离类算法(如 KNN、K-Means)收敛。: Scaling to a fixed interval helps gradient descent and distance-based algorithms (such as KNN and K-Means) converge.
map.：特征取值 10~40，x=25 → [0,1]:(25−10)/30=0.5；: : feature values 10-40 with x=25 -> [0,1]: (25-10)/30 = 0.5; [-1,1]: 2 x 0.5 - 1 = 0.0, exactly the middle of the range. If an outlier of 1000 is included, normal samples all crowd near 0.
map.Min-Max 和 StandardScaler 怎么选？: How to choose between Min-Max and StandardScaler?
map.Min-Max 固定边界、对异常值敏感，适合已知范围(如图像 0~255)；St: Min-Max fixes the bounds and is sensitive to outliers, suiting known ranges (such as image values 0-255); StandardScaler (mean 0, variance 1) is more robust to anomalies and suits most modeling.
map.测试集怎么缩放？: How to scale the test set?
map.必须用训练集的 min/max 缩放测试集，不能用测试集自身统计量，否则引入数据: You must scale the test set with the training set's min/max, not with the test set's own statistics, otherwise you leak data and overstate generalization.
